sv.title: Storägare tankar aktier i MTG för 20 miljoner
sv.summary: MTG:s styrelseledamot Florian Schuhbauer har via bolaget Active Ownership (AOC) köpt drygt 190.000 aktier i gamingbolaget för drygt 20 miljoner kronor.

en.title: Major owner buys MTG shares for SEK 20 million
en.summary: MTG board member Florian Schuhbauer has, via the company Active Ownership (AOC), bought just over 190,000 shares in the gaming company for just over SEK 20 million.
